content.text:
Here's an original speedy blue hedgehog mascot in SVG, inspired by the classic "fast hedgehog" vibe rather than copying Sega's trademarked Sonic design:

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 300 300" width="300" height="300">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2fa4ff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1456c8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shoe" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffb02e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e06a00"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- speed lines -->
  <g stroke="#9fd4ff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="10" y1="140" x2="70" y2="140"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="170" x2="80" y2="170"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="200" x2="65" y2="200"/>
  </g>

  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d="M120 90 L40 70 L95 115 L30 130 L95 145 L45 180 L115 165 Z"
        fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="150" cy="170" rx="38" ry="42" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="4"/>
  <ellipse cx="160" cy="178" rx="22" ry="28" fill="#ffe3b8"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <path d="M135 205 L115 245" stroke="#1456c8" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M165 205 L195 240" stroke="#1456c8" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- shoes -->
  <path d="M90 240 Q95 228 118 238 L128 252 Q105 262 88 254 Z"
        fill="url(#shoe)" stroke="#7a3500" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M188 236 Q200 224 222 236 L228 250 Q205 258 186 250 Z"
        fill="url(#shoe)" stroke="#7a3500" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="95" y="244" width="30" height="5" rx="2" fill="#fff"/>
  <rect x="192" y="241" width="30" height="5" rx="2" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <path d="M180 160 Q210 150 225 130" stroke="#1456c8" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="228" cy="126" r="10" fill="#fff" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M122 165 Q100 180 92 195" stroke="#1456c8" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="198" r="10" fill="#fff" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="160" cy="100" r="46" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <path d="M140 62 L132 34 L158 56 Z" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M141 56 L137 42 L150 54 Z" fill="#ffb3c7"/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="182" cy="118" rx="26" ry="18" fill="#ffe3b8"/>

  <!-- goggles band -->
  <path d="M116 88 Q160 70 204 86" stroke="#333" stroke-width="7" fill="none"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <ellipse cx="178" cy="92" rx="14" ry="16" fill="#fff" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="183" cy="94" r="6" fill="#6a2fd0"/>
  <circle cx="185" cy="91" r="2" fill="#fff"/>
  <!-- brow -->
  <path d="M164 74 Q178 68 192 76" stroke="#0b3a8a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="207" cy="110" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#222"/>

  <!-- grin -->
  <path d="M178 126 Q195 136 206 124" stroke="#5a2a00" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
```

Save it as `hedgehog.svg` and open it in a browser. It's a blue hedgehog with swept-back spikes, purple eyes, a goggle strap, orange sneakers, and speed lines. Tell me if you want different colors, a different pose, or an animated running version.
